title: Software Engineering Methodologies
modules: Introduction To Architectural Design And Models
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of designing a system organization that satisfies the functional and non-functional requirements of a software system."
Architectural design is the process of designing a system organization that satisfies the functional and non-functional requirements of a software system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of managing changing requirements during the requirements engineering process and system development."
Requirements management planning is the process of managing changing requirements during the requirements engineering process and system development.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to illustrate the operational context of a system - they show what lies outside the system boundaries."
Context Models Context models are used to illustrate the operational context of a system - they show what lies outside the system boundaries.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the application of systematic and quantifiable approach in the development, operation, maintenance; and retirement of software."
Software engineering is the application of systematic and quantifiable approach in the development, operation, maintenance; and retirement of software.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process of problem-solving and planning for a software solution."
Software Design Software design is a process of problem-solving and planning for a software solution.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the process whereby sub-systems are decomposed into modules."
Modular Decomposition Modular decomposition refers to the process whereby sub-systems are decomposed into modules.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with demonstrating that the requirements define the system that the customer really wants."
Requirements validation is concerned with demonstrating that the requirements define the system that the customer really wants.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to computer programs including it associated libraries, data and documentation such as requirements, design models and user manuals."
Software simply refers to computer programs including it associated libraries, data and documentation such as requirements, design models and user manuals.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the process of establishing the services that the customer requires from a system and the constraints under which it operates and is developed."
Requirements engineering refers to the process of establishing the services that the customer requires from a system and the constraints under which it operates and is developed.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a technique that can be used to understand operational processes and help derive software requirements that support these processes."
Observation is a technique that can be used to understand operational processes and help derive software requirements that support these processes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are an intrinsic part of many analysis methods."
Data flow diagrams are an intrinsic part of many analysis methods.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the second process activity in traditional requirements engineering process. it is the process of writing the user and system requirements in a requirements document."
Specification is the second process activity in traditional requirements engineering process. it is the process of writing the user and system requirements in a requirements document.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with showing that a software product conforms to its specification and that the product meets the expectations of the customer."
Software Validation Software validation is concerned with showing that a software product conforms to its specification and that the product meets the expectations of the customer.
